The '''Eggplant''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Eggplant Seeds]] after 5 days and continues to produce every 5 days after maturity.

==Stages==
When harvested, each Eggplant bush gives 1 Eggplant every 5 days, with a 0.2% chance for more Eggplants.

==Tailoring==
Eggplant is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a dyeable {{Name|Shirt140|link=Tailoring{{!}}Button Down Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a purple dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the purple dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*Eggplant may be randomly requested in [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|180}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
